Countries in the region have realized, in lights of the developments over the past two or three years,  that security is not a commodity to be purchased from deceptive security brokers.

The Islamic Republic of #Iran sincerely congratulates the friendly and brotherly government and people of the Islamic Republic of #Pakistan on its Independence Day.
We are determined to promote bilateral relations & cooperation in all areas beneficial to our nations.

The Islamic Republic of #Iran sincerely congratulates the friendly, brotherly nation and government of the Republic of #Indonesia on their Independence Day.
We remain committed to further strengthening bilateral relations & cooperation in all areas of mutual interest and benefit.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of #Iran extends its congratulations to the nation and government of the Republic of #IvoryCoast on the occasion of its independence anniversary.

We commemorate the 76th anniversary of Iran-Venezuela diplomatic relations. The Islamic Republic of Iran is committed to preserving and further promoting more than seven decades of ties based on respect for national sovereignty, independence, and the mutual interests of both

The Islamic Republic of #Iran extends its warm congratulations to the friendly government and people of the Republic of #India on its Independence Day. 
We remain committed to further strengthening bilateral relations and cooperation in all areas of mutual interest and benefit.

The most important development in our region following the two wars of aggression waged by the US and Zionist regime against Iran, particularly the most recent one, was that the countries of the region came to the conclusion that the US is an unreliable and untrustworthy partner.
